business_request.question: Which four general operating-condition checks are listed for actual running equipment? Are corresponding measured observations supplied for this rolling-element demonstration?

draft.answer: The supplied cards do not list four general operating-condition checks for actual running equipment, so that part of the request is unsupported within the returned evidence scope. What the cards do provide is preparation/recording guidance for investigating bearing damage: gather operating data from bearing monitoring devices, analyze service and maintenance records and charts, secure application diagrams/graphics/engineering drawings, and prepare an inspection sheet with photographs to document observations [EV-K01-005]. For lubricant sampling, used samples from bearings, housing and seal areas should be separately packaged and properly labelled, and a new unused lubricant sample secured with any available specification or batch information recorded from its container, plus technical specifications and any related material safety documentation accompanying lubricant shipments [EV-K01-006]. Regarding measured observations for this rolling-element demonstration: no actual device records, drawings, photographs, lubricant identity/specification/batch, sampling quantity, or model-specific thresholds are supplied, and the cards state that no operating records, drawings or photographs have actually been collected [EV-K01-005][EV-K01-006]. The poor-lubrication spherical-roller smearing is an independently specified teaching assumption, not an observation or classifier inference; the NSK card reports smearing on convex rollers of the spherical roller bearing in Smearing 5 attributed by the manufacturer to poor lubrication, which is a manufacturer case statement rather than a project observation [EV-I01-002].
